svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.3.2.2 Lumber Grades
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.3 MATERIALS, SYSTEMS AND EQUIPMENT
Visually graded lumber meets the grades in Table
Except joists, rafters, trusses and beams: see 9.23.4.2. for
joists, rafters and beams, and 9.23.14.11. for trusses.
Stud wall framing, loadbearing: Stud, Standard, No. 2
Stud wall framing, non-loadbearing: Stud, Utility, No. 3
Posts and beams 114 mm (4½″) or thicker: Standard
(Para 118). Not a nailing base: No. 5 Common, Economy, No. 5
Roof sheathing boards: No. 3 Common, Standard, No. 4 Common.
Plank frame construction: framing No. 2 (loadbearing) or
Drawn: a framed corner on a floor deck. Joists and the beam are pale because their grades come from 9.23.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.3.2.2. (page 9-11), with Table 9.3.2.1.
